scope: Segment 135 field-level rules and serialization within Moneris-authorizer-destined transactions

rules.title: Segment 135 is required only for transactions destined for the Moneris authorizer
rules.note: Adopted from the pre-existing generic Financial Transaction Request layout table entry: 'Contains data required by the Moneris authorizer. It is required only for transactions destined for the Moneris authorizer.'

rules.title: Segment Type is fixed value 135, sourced at the Device

Segment Length Indicator is 3 digits, identifies the segment's length including Segment Type's length only (NOT explicitly including Field Separators, unlike most other segments' Segment Length description)
rules.note: PROVISIONAL: the wording difference ('including Segment Type's length' vs the usual 'including Segment Type's length and Field Separators') may be intentional or a drafting inconsistency. Pending SME confirmation (SEG135-SME-001).

rules.title: Field Separators appear between fields 1-2 and 2-3; the segment as a whole should end with a trailing Field Separator; data fields contained WITHIN field 3 (Moneris Data) are NOT separated by Field Separators
Moneris Data (Element 213) is required, max 100 characters, in <tag><len><data> TLV-like format; full layout documented in Appendix V (Moneris Data layouts)
rules.note: Appendix V request layouts are transcribed and independently checked in the Appendix V training module; the conflicting Table 004/005 data-width descriptions remain explicitly review-gated.
